name: load-template-library
body: Load template library: resolve the library root from the deck config — the `templates:` path when set (a relative path resolved against the deck root, or an absolute path), otherwise the local `templates/`; neither resolvable = error (templates-dir-required) — then validate the resolved root fail-fast (templates-dir-validation) and build the template and theme registries from its files; the first failure is a templates error. The step-6 reference checks cover a theme's `theme.css` and the CSS it `@import`s from its own theme directory (imports followed, bounded and cycle-safe): each relative `url()` must stay inside the theme directory, and a `url()` with the reserved `media:` prefix must name an existing file under the resolved library's `media/` (relative, no `..`, no absolute), validated like a layout `media` argument and reported with the CSS file and line (theme-media-references). A configured path is authoritative: it never silently falls back to a local `templates/`. The value used by a running session is the one captured at startup: a later change to the configured `templates:` value is not resolved live — the reload path reports the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
